ProgramUnit.Name: ITEM_CHANGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE item_change (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 IF get_item_property(it_id, ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then
 set_item_property(it_id,UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 END IF;
 elsif p_mode = 'D' then
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FOR_ACCESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_for_access IS
 cfpnot_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 cfrnot_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_flg VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
 lv_user_id VARCHAR2(10);
 v_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 
 
 IF SUBSTR(lt_user_session.get_userid, 1, 4) = 'OPS$' THEN
 lv_user_id := SUBSTR(lt_user_session.get_userid, 5);
 ELSE
 lv_user_id := lt_user_session.get_userid;
 END IF; 
 
 -- IM 124
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 --
 
 
 SELECT count(*) INTO cfpnot_cnt
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE user_id = lv_user_id
 AND access_class = 'CFPNO'
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_sysdate+1); -- IM 124
 
 SELECT count(*) INTO cfrnot_cnt
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE user_id = lv_user_id
 AND access_class = 'CFRNO'
 AND v_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, v_sysdate+1); -- IM 124
 
 IF cfpnot_cnt > 0 THEN

 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_save',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_delete',enabled,property_true); 
 END IF;
 
 IF cfrnot_cnt > 0 THEN 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_save',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_delete',enabled,property_true);
 END IF;
 
 
 IF cfpnot_cnt = 0 AND cfrnot_cnt = 0 THEN 
 :ctrl_block.warn:='Your access level is for viewing notation only. Addition/Deletion is denied!!!! ';

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 
begin

 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 if from_where = 'E' then
 if trunc(eff_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if term_date is not null and trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if from_where = 'T' and term_date is not null then
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
end validate_dates;

Trigger.Name: VALID_NOTATION_CODE

declare
cursor cur_record is 
select
 sd.notation_code,
 sd.eff_date,
 sd.term_date 
 from SAMPLE_NOTATION_DETAILS sd
 where sd.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sd.unit_id = :ctrl_block.unit_id
 and term_date <= Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);

cursor cur_notation(ca_notation_code valid_notation_codes.notation_code%type) is
SELECT
 notation_desc,
 short_desc,
 notation_type,
 test_id
FROM
 valid_notation_codes
WHERE ---term_date <= Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) 
 NOTATION_CODE = ca_notation_code;
 
begin 
 
 go_block('SAMPLE_NOTATION_DETAILS');
 clear_block; 
 for rec_record in cur_record
 loop
 for rec_noation in cur_notation(rec_record.notation_code)
 loop
 go_block('SAMPLE_NOTATION_DETAILS');
 first_record;
 :sample_notation_details.notation_code := rec_record.notation_code;
 :sample_notation_details.notation_type := rec_noation.notation_type;
 :sample_notation_details.short_desc := rec_noation.short_desc;
 :sample_notation_details.description := rec_noation.notation_desc; 
 :sample_notation_details.eff_date := rec_record.eff_date;
 :sample_notation_details.term_date := rec_record.term_date;
 end loop;
 end loop;
 next_record;

exception 
when others then 
 null;
end;
